title: Damaged Street and Pedestrian Lighting / Repair Process / Inefficiencies

documents.title: Report from Bureau of Street Lighting

motion: I THEREFORE MOVE that the Bureau of Street Lighting BE DIRECTED to report to the Government Efficiency, Innovation, and Audits on the existing process for repairing damaged street and pedestrian lighting infrastructure and the current timeline for repairs, as well as on potential bottlenecks or inefficiencies in the existing repair process. > I FURTHER MOVE that the Chief Legislative Analyst, with the assistance of the Bureau of Street Lighting, report to Government Efficiency, Innovation, and Audits with a comparative analysis of the street lighting repair process in other major cities, and how best practices in other cities can be adopted for the process in the City of Los Angeles.
